mapper.select: SELECT , b.scene_name, b.scene_status FROM bt_bot_scene_rel a LEFT JOIN bt_bot_scene b ON a.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND a.scene_id = b.scene_id WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND b.status_cd = '00A' AND a.bot_id IN (#{id}) AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT a.rel_id, a.bot_id, b.scene_name, b.scene_id, b.scene_type, a.is_default FROM bt_bot_scene_rel a JOIN bt_bot_scene b ON a.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND a.scene_id = b.scene_id WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND b.status_cd = '00A' AND a.bot_id IN (#{id}) AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND b.scene_status = '1'

SELECT , b.rel_id, b.is_default, (SELECT u.real_name FROM bt_user u WHERE u.user_id = b.creator_id) AS "updatorName", (SELECT u.user_icon FROM bt_user u WHERE u.user_id = b.creator_id) AS "updatorIcon" FROM bt_bot_scene_rel b LEFT JOIN bt_bot_scene a ON a.scene_id = b.scene_id AND a.tenant_id = b.tenant_id WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY b.updated_time DESC

SELECT , b.rel_id, b.is_default, (SELECT u.real_name FROM bt_user u WHERE u.user_id = b.creator_id) AS "updatorName", (SELECT u.user_icon FROM bt_user u WHERE u.user_id = b.creator_id) AS "updatorIcon" FROM bt_bot_scene_rel b LEFT JOIN bt_bot_scene a ON a.scene_id = b.scene_id AND a.tenant_id = b.tenant_id WHERE 1=1

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS existence FROM bt_bot_scene a LEFT JOIN bt_bot_scene_rel r ON a.scene_id = r.scene_id AND a.tenant_id = r.tenant_id WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND r.status_cd = '00A' AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.bot_id = #{botId}

SELECT , b.scene_name, b.scene_status, b.prologue FROM bt_bot_scene_rel a LEFT JOIN bt_bot_scene b ON a.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND a.scene_id = b.scene_id WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND b.status_cd = '00A' AND a.rel_id = #{relId} AND b.scene_status = '1' AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT a.scene_id, a.scene_name, a.scene_status, a.scene_icon, a.scene_desc FROM bt_bot_scene a WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bt_label c, bt_label_object_rel r WHERE c.label_id = r.label_id AND c.label_type = 'scene' AND c.label_name = #{labelName} AND c.status_cd = '00A' AND r.status_cd = '00A' AND r.object_id = a.scene_id AND r.tenant_id = a.tenant_id)
